body:
The findings of the visual review are corrected in 334f6c9 and running in the existing HTTPS app: nine visible defects, three motion durations without staged entrances, one card and one board style, one create action per view, a single colour definition for both themes and six type sizes.

Still open for the owner: accepting the calmer motion and the merged controls. Left unchanged on purpose: spacing token names, the sections shown on a new card and the floating add button on phone Focus. WebKit still fails the existing `responsive` check on the header project picker. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-ui-refinement.md.

metadata.summary: Interface refined after the visual review
